create_BicycleSystem: create a BicycleSystem instance with a time step and optional velocity and angular velocity bounds
run_BicycleSystem_dynamics_fn: run the bicycle model dynamics function to compute linearized A, B, C matrices and the next state
run_BicycleSystem_unroll: run the unroll method to simulate a sequence of controls from a start state and return all states
run_BicycleSystem_get_system_cost: run the get_system_cost method to compute the quadratic cost matrices for tracking a reference trajectory
run_BicycleSystem_get_control_cost: run the get_control_cost method to compute the quadratic cost matrices for a given control input
